column1: # reproduce/tools/scan_allowlist.tsv: the reviewed exemptions of the publication scan (reproduce/tools/scrub_scan.py).
# One row per exemption, four tab-separated fields: path glob, tier, match, reason.
#   match  row:<id>       every hit of that row of the token table (its id) under the glob
#          line:<sha256>  the one line (or document of a gzip corpus) with that sha256 under the glob
#          value:<sha256> one data value; the glob then names its address, <path>#<table.column.key>
# Every row carries its reason. A row that covers nothing on a whole scan is stale and fails the scan, so the list can only
# shrink honestly. Rows are added only after a reviewer has read the hits they cover.
